# sonarqube_cloud_organization_binding (Data Source)

Reads the DevOps platform binding of a SonarQube Cloud organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_key` (String) Key of the organization whose binding is read.

### Read-Only

- `binding_type` (String) Type of the binding, as the API reports it.
- `dev_ops_platform` (String) DevOps platform that the organization is bound to.
- `dev_ops_platform_url` (String) Address of the organization on the DevOps platform.
- `dop_flavor` (String) Variant of the binding, such as `GITHUB_GHEC_DR`. Holds no value for a binding to github.com.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the binding.
- `installation_id` (String) Identifier of the application installation.
- `organization_id` (String) Internal identifier of the bound organization.
- `organization_uuid_v4` (String) Identifier of the bound organization in the form of a UUID.
- `repo_auto_import_enabled` (Boolean) Whether repositories are imported automatically.
